name: Why hire a finish carpenter instead of a general handyman or framer for trim?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a finish carpenter instead of a general handyman or framer for trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: A carpenter handles general construction framing, rough structural work, and basic wood assembly, whereas a finish carpenter specializes in fine, visible woodworking with tight tolerances. Kitchen finish carpentry requires specialized tools like compound miter saws, micro-pin nailers, and scribing tools to join corners seamlessly. Older or shifting walls are rarely plumb, and kitchen ceilings frequently bow. A finish carpenter understands how to scribe trim to follow crooked surfaces, cope inside joints so they stay tight during seasonal wood movement, and disguise uneven ceiling transitions above upper cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpenters specialize in millimeter-level precision, coping inside corners, and scribing moldings to uneven walls and ceilings.
